notes.title: 2.0 Update Log
notes.content:
1.	Unlock the character flying function.
2.	Remake the Fangcun Mountain map.
3.	Optimize the scene of the Misty Swamp instance.
4.	Adjust the HP and damage of some Demon Lords.

notes.title: 1.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
1.	Added Russian language support
2.	Optimized the Inferno Prison instance
3.	Adjusted drop rates for all monster loot
4.	Reduced HP for monsters and demon lords
5.	Adjusted some UI interfaces and fonts
6.	Adjusted loot selling prices
7.	Adjusted main character's HP

notes.title: Version 1.1 Update Log
notes.content:
1.Added the effect that using the light staff reduces the posture value of the BOSS.
2.Increased the initial damage of the magic treasures.
3.Increased the starting capital that the characters carry at birth.
4.Reduced the damage dealt by the BOSSes including Lady Bloodshadow,  Flame Demon, and Bone Enchantress, and adjusted some of their skills.
5. To load the changes in the above version, you need to delete the save file located at C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\SixEar.
